scientific_integrity: Proof is analytic for every integer cycle size at least five. Reproducible exact symbolic checks are supplementary. This document does not claim independent certification, historical uniqueness or full low-price optimization.
scientific_limitations: For the inexpensive closing edge, only mandatory activation and a strict objective gain are proved; no full optimal rate formulas are claimed there. The critical optimal interval has a generalized-eigenvalue endpoint for arbitrary cycle size and a radical only at five vertices. The four-cycle specialization was established earlier. A prior-publication risk remains from unindexed historical minimax work; independent audit has not occurred.
title: A sharp exceptional-edge price cutoff and optimizer interval for fastest mixing on cycles
